title: Bulk change lists a part deleted meanwhile as Part not found
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NOTFOUND-01) is tracked at {Location-A}, is on no work order or return and is active.
  • Inventory part {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NOTFOUND-02) is tracked at {Location-A}, is on no work order or return and is active.
  • {Part-A} and {Part-B} share the start of their numbers (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NOTFOUND-0), so one search lists them together.
  • A second browser tab is open on Parts → Inventory at {Location-A}.
custom_steps:
1. In the first tab search the shared start (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NOTFOUND-0), turn on "Deactivate parts" and tick both parts.
  2. In the second tab open {Part-B} and click "Delete Part".
  3. In the first tab click "Deactivate" and confirm with "Deactivate".
  4. Read the message.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: {Part-B} is deleted.
  • Step 4: The message reads "1 part updated, 1 could not be changed." and lists {Part-B} by its number with the reason "Part not found."; {Part-A} has moved to the Inactive tab.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S10-R13, S10-R13a, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas 13 Oct copy: no board shows a failed bulk change. Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S10-R13: “For each part that failed, the system names the part by its number and gives the reason.”
  • S10-R13a: “The reasons are "A core follows its part. Activate or deactivate the part instead.", "Part not found." and "Part is already in that state."”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (A part missing when the change runs): “"Part not found." | Listed as the failure reason”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Bulk change, some parts failed): “"{n} parts updated, {m} could not be changed." ("1 part updated, {m} could not be changed." for one) | Error toast, stays until closed, lists each failed part and its reason”
